subject: Hero
text: The hero should reach level 30 before fighting the final boss, since fighting with less is very dangerous.

evidence.quote: Level 30 is something you'll easily reach over the course of the game, as attempting to fight the final boss with less is practically a death wish.

subject: Hero
text: Grind the Hero to about level 3 before searching for the Prince of Cannock, then grind the Prince around Cannock and at the Lake Cave east of it.

evidence.quote: Recommended to do before heading to Moonbrooke. Get to around level 3 with the Hero, then initiate the search for the Prince of Cannock. Now having two party members, grind his levels up a bit around Cannock as he joins at level 1, then head to the Lake Cave east of Cannock and grind there.

subject: Princess of Moonbrooke
text: Unlock the Princess of Moonbrooke as the third party member and grind around Hamlin, since she starts at level 1 and the Hero should be near level 12.

evidence.quote: Again, prioritize unlocking the Princess of Moonbrooke as your third party member. She will start at level 1, so grind around Hamlin for a while until she has enough levels, while the Hero gets closer to around level 12.

subject: Hamlin
text: Grinding around Hamlin is sufficient because a healing spot is nearby, while the Tower of the Wind has stronger enemies for more experience.

evidence.quote: Grinding around Hamlin should suffice as you are close to a healing spot, but the Tower of the Wind does have stronger enemies for more experience, so take whichever you prefer doing.

subject: Lianport
text: Grinding around Lianport is a good option, and after getting the boat you can reach Tantegal.

evidence.quote: Grinding around Lianport is generally not a bad idea, and once you get the boat you can also get to Tantegal.

subject: Metal Slime
text: Metal Slimes appear in good numbers outside Osterfair, making it a comfortable grinding spot for levels 17 to 25.

evidence.quote: **Level 17 to 25** - I find it comfortable to grind outside Osterfair, as here are good enemy spawns including Metal Slimes, sometimes in big groups too.

subject: Metal Slime
text: Even killing a single Metal Slime gives a large amount of experience.

evidence.quote: While you will certainly not kill all Metal Slimes, even killing just one will be a great source of experience.

subject: Rhone Cave
text: Rhone Cave can be entered early to grind with the exploit, but it is tough to get through.

evidence.quote: Do mind that you can go to Rhone Cave already and start grinding with the exploit, but it will be tough to get through the cave.

subject: Metal Babble
text: At levels 26 to 30, Metal Babbles in Rhone Cave give more experience but are tougher to kill and appear alone.

evidence.quote: **Level 26 to 30** - Either keep killing Metal Slimes, or move on to Rhone Cave where you can encounter Metal Babbles for even more experience...

subject: Rhone Cave
text: The Lightning Sword is obtained in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: The downside of Rhone Cave is that it has a ton of strong enemies, but you want to get here anyway to get the Lightning Sword and, even though you won't use it right away, the Sword of Darkness as a drop from giants.

subject: Giants
text: The Sword of Darkness can be obtained as a drop from giants in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: The downside of Rhone Cave is that it has a ton of strong enemies, but you want to get here anyway to get the Lightning Sword and, even though you won't use it right away, the Sword of Darkness as a drop from giants.

subject: Rhone Monolith
text: Rhone Monolith has a save and heal spot, and grinding there or at Hargon's Castle gives high experience.

evidence.quote: Grinding both at the Rhone Monolith, as well as Hargon's Castle are both highly recommended due to the high experience drops, and Rhone Monolith having a save/heal spot.

subject: Moonbrooke Castle
text: The secret basement of Moonbrooke Castle is reached by going outside from the top-left part of the castle and following the left wall downwards to an entrance with stairs.

evidence.quote: Once in Moonbrooke Castle, head to the top-left part of the castle and go outside. Then hug the left wall going downwards to find an entrance, leading to stairs.

subject: Midenhall Castle
text: After getting the Golden Key, the right-side door of Midenhall Castle leads to a room with five chests.

evidence.quote: Once you have found the Golden Key, head to Midenhall Castle and open the door on the right side to lead to a room with five chests. One of those chests has the Token of Erdrick.

subject: Midenhall Castle five-chest room
text: One of the five chests in the room behind the right-side door of Midenhall Castle contains the Token of Erdrick.

evidence.quote: Once you have found the Golden Key, head to Cannock Castle and open the door here to find a chest with the Shield of Erdrick.

subject: Helmet of Erdrick
object: Exchange Token of Erdrick at holy shrine south of Rimuldar
text: The Helmet of Erdrick is obtained by exchanging the Token of Erdrick at the holy shrine south of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Token of Erdrick, head to the holy shrine south of Rimuldar (same location as Dragon Warrior 1) and exchange the token for the helmet.

subject: Dragonlord's grandson
text: The Dragonlord's grandson is in Charlock Castle, reached by a cave south-east of Tintegal.

evidence.quote: you can find Charlock Castle south-east of Tintegal. ... Go into the cave and keep following the path until you arrive at the floor with two stairs next to each other.

subject: Dragonlord's grandson
object: Western stairs on the two-stair floor
text: The Dragonlord's grandson is reached by taking the western stairs on the floor with two stairs and following the path.

evidence.quote: To find the Dragonlord's grandson, take the western stairs and follow the path.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: The Sword of Erdrick is in a chest reached by taking the southern stairs on the two-stair floor and following the path.

evidence.quote: To find the Sword of Erdrick, take the southern stairs and follow the path until you reach a chest.

subject: Rhone Cave
text: The Thunder Sword is in Rhone Cave, reached through floors 1 to 4 by taking stairs and then falling through pits.

evidence.quote: The Thunder Sword is located in the Rhone Cave. To get to this item, you need to: ... On the right side of the floor are two stairs going up. You can take either. ... Go right until you have passed two paths going up- and down. Take the third one for stairs. ... Take the stairs in the north-eastern corner of the floor (go north from where you start). Take the stairs you see right after this one as well. ... Fall down in any pit, or take the stairs at the northern part of the room if you somehow miraculously fail to find a pit. Then, go to the bottom-left of the room to fall in another pit, which will bring you to the Thunder Sword.

subject: Rhone Cave
text: The Armor of Erdrick is in Rhone Cave, reached through floors 1 to 4 by taking stairs and then opening the only chest on floor 4.

evidence.quote: The Armor of Erdrick is located in the Rhone Cave. To get to this item, you need to: ... On the right side of the floor are two stairs going up. You can take either. ... Go right until you have passed two paths going up- and down. Take the third one for stairs. ... Take the stairs in the south-eastern corner of the floor (go north from where you start). Take the stairs you see right after this one as well. ... Open the only chest you see here.

subject: Staff of Thunder
text: The Staff of Thunder requires the Jailor's Key to obtain.

evidence.quote: The Staff of Thunder requires the Jailor's Key to get.

subject: Midenhall Castle basement
text: Defeating the locked-up evil clown in the Midenhall Castle basement gives the Staff of Thunder.

evidence.quote: Once you have that, head back to Midenhall Castle and go in the basement to find a locked-up evil clown. Defeat him in battle to receive the Staff of Thunder.

subject: Armor of Gaia
text: The Armor of Gaia requires the Golden Key to obtain.

evidence.quote: The Armor of Gaia requires the Golden Key to get.

subject: Osterfair
object: Golden Key door behind the weapon shop
text: Walking around the weapon shop in Osterfair reveals a Golden Key door.

evidence.quote: Once you have that, head to Osterfair and walk around the weapon shop to find a Golden Key door.

subject: Osterfair weapon shop chests
text: Entering the weapon shop from behind through the Golden Key door gives access to chests containing the Armor of Gaia.

evidence.quote: Once you have that, enter the weapon shop from behind and loot the chests here for the Armor of Gaia.

subject: Water Flying Cloth
text: Making the Water Flying Cloth requires the Magic Loom and the Dew's Yarn.

evidence.quote: The Water Flying Cloth requires two items: the Magic Loom and the Dew's Yarn.

subject: Northern Dragon Horn tower third floor
text: The Dew's Yarn is on the third floor of the northern Dragon Horn tower, about five steps right and two steps down from the stairs leading down.

evidence.quote: The Dew's Yarn can be found on the third floor of the northern Dragon Horn tower (the one you didn't need to enter). You need to search the floor somewhere here for the Dew's Yarn, which should be five steps right and two steps down from the stairs leading down.

subject: Zahan
text: The Magic Loom is found in Zahan and requires the Jailor's Key.

evidence.quote: The Magic Loom can be found in Zahan, and requires the Jailor's Key. Cast StepGuard to pass the damaging floors, then open the door on the west for this item.

subject: Zahan damaging floors
text: Passing the damaging floors in Zahan requires casting StepGuard, then opening the west door to reach the Magic Loom.

evidence.quote: Cast StepGuard to pass the damaging floors, then open the door on the west for this item.

subject: Tuhn weaver
text: Giving both items to the weaver in Tuhn, then saving, resetting, and talking to the weaver again yields the Water Flying Cloth.

evidence.quote: Once you have both items, head to Tuhn and given both items to the weaver. Save your game and reset, then talk to the weaver again to receive the Water Flying Cloth.

subject: World Tree
object: West and slight south of the Shrine of Fire
text: The World Tree is west and slightly south of the Shrine of Fire, and east of the peninsula of Wellgarth.

evidence.quote: The World Tree is located west and slight south of the Shrine of Fire, as well as east of the peninsula of Wellgarth.

subject: World Tree
text: A sacred leaf is found by searching the trees in the middle of the World Tree.

evidence.quote: Walk up to the trees in the middle and search to find a leaf.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: The NES version has no guaranteed chest for the Wizard's Ring, so it must be won from the Lottery by lining up three Star symbols or obtained as a rare battle drop.

evidence.quote: In the NES version, there are no guaranteed chests/locations containing a Wizard's Ring. You'll either need to win one from the Lottery (line up three Star symbols) or get one as a rare drop after battle.

subject: Bullwong
text: Bullwong drops the Wizard's Ring with a 1/32 chance and is found in Hargon's Castle and on the world map just before it.

evidence.quote: Bullwong (1/32 chance): Located in Hargon's castle and on the world map just before it.

subject: Hork
text: Hork drops the Wizard's Ring with a 1/128 chance and is easiest to find on the lower level of the Cave to Rhone.

evidence.quote: Hork (1/128 chance): Most easily found at the lower level of the Cave to Rhone, where they're pretty easy to kill and have a high encounter rate.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: Use the Wizard's Ring in battle while MP is not full to earn the achievement.

evidence.quote: However you get one, use it in battle when your MP is not full and the achievement is yours.

subject: Tantegel weapon shop
text: After getting the Golden Key, the stairs up from the Tantegel weapon shop lead to a door behind which the missing king is found.

evidence.quote: In Tantegel, head up the weapon shop stairs once you have the Golden Key.

subject: Metal Babble
object: Tuhn; Tower of the Moon; Malroth's Cavern; Rhode Cave; Hargon's Castle
text: The Metal Babble can be found around Tuhn, in the Tower of the Moon, in Malroth's Cavern, in Rhode Cave, and in Hargon's Castle.

evidence.quote: The Metal Babble can be found in five locations: ... Around Tuhn. ... In the Tower of the Moon. ... In Malroth's Cavern. ... In Rhode Cave. ... In Hargon's Castle.

subject: Metal Babble
text: For the Metal Babble achievement, wait until reaching Rhode Cave or Hargon's Castle, since they are very tough to kill there.

evidence.quote: For this achievement, I would just recommend waiting until you get to Rhode Cave/Hargon's Castle, as they are very tough to kill.

subject: Metal Babble
text: A Falcon Sword is recommended for the Metal Babble kill, and the weapon exploit in step 4 guarantees a kill sooner.

evidence.quote: A Falcon Sword is recommended, but if you want to guarantee getting this achievement, the weapon exploit mentioned in step 4 will guarantee you a kill rather sooner than later.

subject: Metal Babble
text: Metal Babbles can easily flee, so multiple encounters will likely be necessary to kill one.

evidence.quote: As always, keep in mind that they can easily flee, so multiple encounters will likely be necessary.

subject: Golden Key and Jailor's Key
text: The guide says the hunt for the Golden and Jailor's Key can start at Level 13 to 16, alongside goals like Erdrick's Sword.

evidence.quote: **Level 13 to 16** - Grinding around Lianport is generally not a bad idea, and once you get the boat you can also get to Tantegal. This is the point where you can start hunting for the Golden and Jailor's Key though, so just work towards that as well as other goals, like Erdrick's Sword.

subject: Sword of Darkness
text: Giants in Rhone Cave drop the Sword of Darkness, which the guide strongly recommends getting.

evidence.quote: The downside of Rhone Cave is that it has a ton of strong enemies, but you want to get here anyway to get the Lightning Sword and, even though you won't use it right away, the Sword of Darkness as a drop from giants. You definitely want to get this sword, trust me.

subject: Missing king of Tantegel
text: In Tantegel, with the Golden Key, go up the weapon shop stairs, open the door, and talk with the king inside.

evidence.quote: In Tantegel, head up the weapon shop stairs once you have the Golden Key. Then open the door and talk with the king inside.
